# Muhit

> Muhit (مُحِيط) is an offline Arabic-English dictionary app for iPhone and Android, made in Sweden. It has 48,000+ fully vowelled Arabic words with roots, plurals and example sentences, full verb conjugation tables (every person, tense and mood, active and passive), root browsing, word lists for the Madinah and Bayna Yadayk Arabic courses, folders, flashcards and quizzes with spaced repetition, and Mi'rab AI, a tool that explains the i'rāb (grammatical analysis) of an Arabic sentence word by word. It works without an account; an optional account syncs saved words between devices. No ads, no tracking.

## Guides
- [Arabic roots explained: how to find a word by its root](https://muhit.site/guides/arabic-roots/): What an Arabic root is, how patterns build words from it, and how to find the root of any Arabic word, with examples from ك ت ب.
- [Arabic verb conjugation: tenses, moods and the 13 persons](https://muhit.site/guides/arabic-verb-conjugation/): A short guide to conjugating Arabic verbs: the 13 persons, the past and present tenses, the subjunctive, jussive, imperative, emphatic and passive forms.
- [What is i'rāb? Arabic sentence analysis explained](https://muhit.site/guides/what-is-irab/): I'rāb (إعراب) explained simply: the case and mood endings of Arabic, the four signs, and worked examples of analysing a sentence word by word.
- [Muhit vs Hans Wehr: which Arabic dictionary should you use?](https://muhit.site/compare/muhit-vs-hans-wehr/): How Muhit compares with Hans Wehr's Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic: lookup by root or by spelling, verb tables, offline use and practice.
